name: Gengar
normal: purple body, red eyes, white teeth
shiny: nearly identical; very slightly darker, marginally bluer purple
note: Bogleech says regular Gengar shiny barely differs; kept the shift subtle. Bulbapedia blocked (403).

name: Starmie
normal: purple-lavender body, red core gem, yellow ring
shiny: blue body (hue ~258), purple core gem, salmon-pink ring
desc: body turns blue; red gem turns purple; yellow ring turns salmon
source: pokemondb.net HOME normal/shiny sprites, paired-pixel OKLCh measurement (re-verified)
note: Re-measured: body hue 280-300 (65%, L 0.69, C 0.10) to hue 258, C x0.8, L x0.93; red gem hue 5-30 (center 16, 12%) to hue 301-310, C x0.65; yellow ring hue 80-120 (21%) to hue 22-28, C x0.6, L x0.73-0.8. Gem rule re-centered on 16 (was 10) so the destination lands on 302.

name: Typhlosion
normal: cream-yellow body, dark navy back, red flames
shiny: paler cream body (hue unchanged), brown back, orange flames
desc: flames turn orange; navy back turns brown; cream gets paler
source: pokemondb.net HOME normal/shiny sprites, paired-pixel OKLCh measurement (re-verified)
note: Re-measured: cream body hue 85-105 (82%, C 0.15) stays hue ~96-102, C x0.65-0.69; flames hue 20-30 (455 px, center ~24) to hue 47-64, L x1.16, C x0.74; navy back hue 200-240 (2%, L 0.29, C 0.05) to hue ~18, L x1.75 (brown). Flame rule re-centered on 24 with window 16 (was 30+-12) so the shift lands on 52 and the flame hue 20-40 range is fully covered. Back chroma is near the 0.04 cutoff.

name: Crobat
normal: purple body, pale blue wing membranes
shiny: body turns pink-magenta and lighter, wing membranes turn yellow-green
desc: purple body to pink, blue wings to yellow-green
note: Re-measured. Purple (hue 300-320, 62% of body) to 332 with chroma x0.58 and L x1.25. Blue wings (220-240, 33%) to 117 with chroma x1.8. Pixel error vs shiny sprite 0.175 to 0.024.

name: Lanturn
normal: dark blue body, light blue underside, yellow lure
shiny: body shifts to pink/magenta-purple, lure stays yellow
note: Matches recollection of pink shiny Chinchou line; not visually verified this session. Overlapping windows are safe since shifted hues (335-345) fall outside both. Yellow lure (100) untouched.

name: Natu
normal: green body, red/yellow markings, grey-black beak/feet
note: Target hue moved from 215 to 230 so it reads as blue like Xatu's shiny; not visually verified. Red/yellow markings (29, 100) are outside the window (105-185).

name: Qwilfish
normal: dark blue back, cream-yellow underside and spikes
shiny: back turns bright pink-magenta, underside turns pale pink-lilac
desc: blue back to pink, cream belly to faint pink
note: Re-measured. Back (hue 180-220, 33%, L0.46) to ~334 with L about x1.5 and chroma about x1.9. Cream (100-140, 61%) to ~322 at about half chroma. Pixel error 0.199 to 0.025.

name: Houndoom
normal: near-black grey body, orange-tan muzzle/underside, bone horns
shiny: dark body gets a clear blue-violet tint, tan parts become pale yellow, horns stay pale
desc: dark body tinted blue-violet, tan turns pale yellow
note: Re-measured. Grey body texels (L0.3-0.7, 65% of pixels) go to hue 269 at chroma about 0.09. Orange 40-80 goes to ~76-112 at about half chroma (hue coherence only 0.6). Horn greys (L>0.7) stay neutral. Medium because the grey tint is a strong guess for how the texture stores the near-black. Pixel error 0.091 to 0.031.

name: Lugia
normal: white/silver body, blue back stripes and underside
shiny: blue markings turn red-pink, whites unchanged
note: Re-measured. Blue 240-260 goes to 355 and darker blue 260-280 goes to 18-24, so one +105 rotation with chroma about x0.85. Greys (81% of pixels) are nearly unchanged. Pale blue-grey texels (C 0.03-0.06) get a faint pink tint from the rule, negligible. Pixel error 0.056 to 0.026.

name: Lotad
normal: large green lily pad, small blue body, cream face
shiny: pad turns muted teal, small body turns red-pink and darker, cream face unchanged
desc: green pad to muted teal, blue body to red
note: Re-measured. Pad (hue 120-140, 88% of pixels) goes to 189 with chroma x0.4. Blue body (220-240, 7%) goes to ~3 and L x0.59. Yellow-green 80-120 goes to ~100 with chroma x0.7, so the pad window is narrow. Pixel error 0.155 to 0.024.

name: Ho-Oh
normal: red-orange body, yellow-gold feathers, green tail tips, white
shiny: red turns gold, yellow feathers wash out to near white/silver, green tips turn orange, whites get a warm cream tint
desc: red to gold, yellow to silver, green to orange
note: Re-measured. Red (20-40, 45%) to ~81, chroma x0.7. Yellow (80-100, 23%) loses nearly all chroma (to 0.012, incoherent hue). Green (120-140, 8%) to ~42. Whites (L>0.8) are mixed: some get strong gold, some stay neutral, so the 0.08 tint is a compromise. Medium because yellow-to-silver is a desaturation and the white tint is spatially patterned. Pixel error 0.171 to 0.054.

name: Shiftry
normal: green leaf fans, brown face and body, white/cream fur
shiny: brown turns red-brown, leaves turn lighter lime-yellow-green, whites get warm cream tint
desc: brown to red-brown, leaves to lime, fur cream
note: Re-measured. Brown (40-80, 35%) to ~19. Green (140-160, 25%) to ~126, chroma x0.78. Light greys (37%) tinted to hue ~95 at chroma 0.05. Pixel error 0.077 to 0.025.

name: Mawile
normal: dark grey-blue body, cream-yellow jaw/face, pink-red mouth details
shiny: dark body takes a dark rose tint, mouth details shift to red-orange, cream unchanged
desc: dark body tinted rose, pink details to red
note: Re-measured. Grey body (L0.3-0.5, 56%) goes to hue ~351 chroma ~0.08 with L about the same. Pink (340-360, 8%) goes to ~18. Cream 80-120 (32%) unchanged. Medium: the grey tint is measured but unexpected. Pixel error 0.064 to 0.032.

name: Torkoal
normal: dark grey body, orange shell with yellow-tan patches, red glow
shiny: orange shell turns pale yellow, grey body turns dusty red-rose, light greys warm slightly
desc: orange shell to pale yellow, grey body to dusty rose
note: Re-measured. Orange 40-60 (10%) and yellow-orange 60-80 (23%) both go to ~88. Yellow 80-100 stays. Grey body (L0.3-0.7, 13%) tints to hue ~22 chroma 0.065. The grey rule cannot raise lightness (shiny grey is lighter by about 0.15). Medium because of that. Pixel error 0.055 to 0.035.

name: Gardevoir
normal: white gown, green hair and chest spike, red horn
shiny: green parts turn pale blue-azure, horn turns orange, whites unchanged
desc: green hair to blue, red horn to orange
note: Re-measured. Green (120-140, 30%) to 234 with chroma x0.56. Red/pink horn (340-360, 2%) to ~53. Whites (64%) stay neutral. Pixel error 0.066 to 0.024.

name: Altaria
shiny: blue shifts toward pink/magenta, white stays
note: Matches recollection of pink shiny Altaria; not visually verified this session. Shifted hues fall outside both windows.

name: Cradily
normal: mostly green body with pink-red details, yellow ring, light cream-pink tentacles
shiny: green turns red, pink details turn orange, yellow mostly unchanged, light cream-pink becomes tan-orange
desc: green body to red, pink to orange, cream to tan
note: Re-measured; rules changed. Green (120-140, 56%) to ~6. Pink 340-360 (13%) to ~47. Cream-pink 0-20 (15%, low chroma) to ~54 with chroma x1.8: the old pink window (338-2) missed these, leaving 18% of pixels unmatched; new 12>56 rule catches them. Yellow 80-120 (13%) shifts slightly to ~88 with chroma x0.75. Light near-greys tint to hue ~54. Rules read the original hue, so order only matters where windows overlap. Pixel error 0.180 to 0.020.
